title: Fleet Management: observability metrics instrumentation (Plan 20 gap 1)
description:
Implement fleet observability metrics from Plan 20 §15.1 — fleet_* gauges, counters, and histograms. The fleet control loop and routing code exists at internal/sandbox/control/fleet/ but metrics are not instrumented.

Key deliverables:
- Fleet pool size, warm pool, healthy instance gauges
- Provisioning/destruction counters and latency histograms
- Routing decision metrics
- Unit tests for metrics emission

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/20-fleet-management.md §15.1
